Full Stop.name: Full Stop
Full Stop.description: The user runs down anything moving on the ground, from a getaway car or a runaway bus to a fleeing speedster, and matches speed alongside. They plant their heels and fire the engines against the motion: a vehicle halts without crashing or rolling, so nobody aboard is hurt, and a fleeing person is pinned until they break free with a hard effort or the user lets go. Strain: severe.
